module_role: Exact project/title-block/sheet/scale context and complete full-page visual-review ledger for the supplied thirteen-sheet set.
scope: Complete ground truth for the thirteen supplied sheets only. The ledger does not assert that unprovided disciplines, revisions, records or controller submittals are part of the source.

project.name: GUARANTEED RATE FIELD - HVAC / AHU RENOVATION - PHASE IX

revision_date.note: Blank revision-log heading/rows are not reclassified as revision events.

scale_semantics.finding: All thirteen supplied pages were visually reviewed. M0.02/M0.03/M0.04 print 1/32" = 1'-0"; the M1 work-plan sheets print VARIES; M2.01/M3.01/M4.01/M4.02 print AS NOTED. The cover does not establish a plan scale. No source page is treated as having a universal measurable scale when its title block says VARIES or AS NOTED.
scale_semantics.global_measured_takeoff_warning: Per-view scales may need to be read from individual captions on VARIES/AS NOTED sheets; no global conversion is invented from the title block.
